action-masseditregex: Samee wax ka beddel tiro badan
masseditregex: Wax ka beddel tiro badan adigoo adeegsanaya tibaaxaha caadiga ah
masseditregex-desc: Waxay kuu oggolaanaysaa inaad isticmaasho tibaaxaha caadiga ah si aad [[Special:MassEditRegex|hal hawlgal ugu wax ka beddelato bogag badan]]
masseditregextext:
Geli hal tibaax caadi ah ama ka badan (mid kasta khadkiisa) oo loogu talagalay iswaafajinta, iyo hal tibaax ama ka badan oo lagu beddelayo iswaafajin kasta.
Tibaaxda ugu horreysa ee iswaafajinta, haddii ay guulaysato, waxaa lagu beddeli doonaa tibaaxda ugu horreysa ee beddelka, iyo sidaas oo kale.
Faahfaahin ka eeg [https://php.net/function.preg-replace shaqada PHP ee preg_replace()].
masseditregex-err-nopages: Waa inaad sheegtaa ugu yaraan hal bog oo la beddelayo.
masseditregex-max-preview-diffs: Horudhaca waxaa lagu xaddiday iswaafajinta ugu horreysa ee $1 {{PLURAL:$1|iswiwaafajin|iswaafajino}}.
masseditregex-view-full-summary: Eeg koobanaha wax ka beddelka oo dhammaystiran
masseditregex-hint-intro: Halkan waxaa ku jira tilmaamo iyo tusaalooyin kaa caawinaya inaad qabato hawlo caadi ah:
masseditregex-hint-toappend: Ku dar qoraal dhammaadka bogga — aad bay ugu habboon tahay in bogag lagu daro qaybaha
masseditregex-hint-remove: Ka saar qoraal bogagga oo dhan ee ku jira liiska
masseditregex-hint-removecat:
Ka saar dhammaan qaybaha bogga (ogow in xarfaha labajibbaaran ee ku jira wikicode-ka la baxsaday.)
Qiimayaasha beddelka waa inaan la baxsan.
masseditregex-hint-renamelink: AAA ku beddel BBB qoraalka xiriiriyaha, laakiin ha beddelin halka xiriiriyuhu ku socdo: [[AAA|AAA]] waxay noqonaysaa [[AAA|BBB]]
masseditregex-listtype-pagename-prefixes: Horgalayaasha magacyada bogagga (wax ka beddel bogagga magacyadoodu ku bilaabmaan qoraalkan)
masseditregex-listtype-categories: Magacyada qaybaha (wax ka beddel bog kasta oo ku jira qaybahan)
masseditregex-listtype-backlinks: Xiriiriyeyaasha dib u noqoshada (wax ka beddel bogagga xiriiriya bogaggan)
masseditregex-exprnomatch: Tibaaxda "$1" kuma aysan helin wax bogag ah.
masseditregex-badregex: Tibaax caadi ah oo aan sax ahayn:
right-masseditregex: Ku beddel nuxurka bogagga adigoo adeegsanaya tibaaxaha caadiga ah
masseditregex-norevisions: Lama helin wax noocyo ah oo wax laga beddelo
masseditregex-js-execution: Sax tan si aad bogagga ugu kala shaqayso dhinaca macmiilka ee biraawsarka. Tani waxay kuu oggolaanaysaa isbeddello waaweyn oo caadi ahaan uu xaddido waqtiga ugu badan ee fulinta PHP.
masseditregex-js-mwapi-api-error: Khalad: MediaWiki API waxay soo celisay koodhka khaladka $1: $2
masseditregex-js-mwapi-general-error: Khalad: Natiijo aan la garanayn ayaa laga helay MediaWiki API.
masseditregex-js-mwapi-unknown-error: Khalad: Khalad aan la garanayn ayaa dhacay intii lagu jiray codsiga MediaWiki API.
